laws.rule: Retezat National Park: visit ticket 10 lei per person, valid 7 days with multiple entries; under 18 exempt. Buy online, by SMS, at main entrances or the Nucșoara visitor centre; keep it for inspection. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 10 lei ≈ A$2.98)
laws.heading: Retezat National Park

laws.rule: Retezat National Park: stay on marked trails; tents only in designated areas; no open fires (portable stoves only in camping areas); dogs on a lead; no bathing, boats or detergents in park waters; no motor vehicles or bikes on hiking trails.
